description: This is a vintage television with a wooden frame and a CRT screen. The screen displays a reflection of a classroom with rows of desks and chairs. The television has two prominent knobs on the right side for tuning and volume, and a speaker grille below them. The Hitachi logo is visible on the front panel. The overall design suggests an older era of television technology, likely from the late 20th century, and it appears to be in good condition despite its age.
